correctness.rationale: Direct divisor-sum factorization reduces both GCDs to min(b,v_p(2^(2a+1)-1)) versus min(2b,v). Multiplicative order and LTE prove the exact divisibility criterion, with odd modulus ensuring one congruence class. Only O_p(log N) b-values can contribute beyond b<c, giving the linear main term plus O_p(log N). Independent brute GCD enumeration verified all primes below 50, exponents a≤20,b≤4; symbolic proof covers all.

value.rationale: The motivating conjecture concerns the density of a concrete divisor-sum GCD set; this gives a natural complete, all-primes classification of the first mixed prime-power support, exact positive densities for fixed b, and a distinct two-dimensional count with an explicit linear leading constant and logarithmic error. It exhibits noncommuting sparsity regimes and reveals arithmetic dependence on order parity and Wieferich valuations. The full infinite family and count are more than individual instances or a known finite table.
